evidence: Labeled Wallet and modifies src/wallet/rpc/encrypt.cpp to deprecate encryptwallet for already existing wallets.
rationale: Deprecating post-creation wallet encryption addresses serious fund safety footguns where creating new keys upon encryption invalidates pre-encryption backups and silently alters spending conditions on manually imported descriptors. Gating this hazardous behavior behind -deprecatedrpc=encryptwallet is a strategic prerequisite to full removal in #36027.
